description: This file defines structures, enums, and classes related to managing TLS parameters, fingerprint storage, and TLS spinning sessions within a network communication context. It includes functionality for saving, loading, and migrating TLS fingerprints, as well as handling TLS authentication challenges in a WebSocket session.

classes.name: GatewayTLSPinningSession
classes.description: Handles WebSocket sessions with custom TLS handling, including server trust authentication challenges, fingerprint verification, and optional fingerprint storage.

methods.name: loadFingerprint
methods.description: Loads the TLS fingerprint from secure storage, performing migration from UserDefaults if needed.

methods.name: saveFingerprint
methods.description: Saves the TLS fingerprint to secure storage.

methods.name: clearFingerprint
methods.description: Removes the stored fingerprint for a specific stableID.

methods.name: clearAllFingerprints
methods.description: Removes all stored fingerprints from secure storage.

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket task configured with specific message size limits.

methods.name: urlSession(_:didReceive:completionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles server trust authentication challenges, verifying certificates against expected fingerprints or allowing Trust on First Use (TOFU) if permitted.
